title: Memory Tool Result Truncation and Bloat Containment
goal: Cap memory_backend.execute response size at 2 KB per call and refactor /memories/run-progress.md from an unbounded log into a bounded structured summary. Reduces ~9 KB per memory tool call wasted on the picker prompt (~922 calls/day observed = ~$30/day saving with current pricing).
scope: Modify api/app/services/memory_backend.py to truncate view command results to 2 KB with a trailing [...truncated, N more bytes] marker. Add a separate maintenance helper that periodically rotates /memories/run-progress.md when it exceeds 8 KB, keeping only the most recent 6 KB of content.
generation_reason: Observed 2026-05-15: /memories/run-progress.md grew to 77 KB causing every picker hop with a memory view to inject ~11 KB into the prompt. Memory tool result mean is 11 KB across 922 calls/day. Truncation is purely cost optimization with minimal quality impact: Claude can read incremental notes per file instead of one giant file.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Truncation + rotation only. Do NOT change the memory tool schema, the system prompt directives about /memories paths, or any storage backend.
constraints.preserve_writes: Writes are NOT capped. Only reads are truncated for prompt-injection bounds. The full file remains on disk.
constraints.no_quality_regression: Truncation must include a clear marker that prompts Claude to view sub-paths or read further if needed. Do not silently drop content.

success_criteria: memory_backend.execute view results capped at 2 KB with truncation marker.
Rotation helper for /memories/run-progress.md keeps file under 8 KB.
Logged cache_read_input_tokens per picker hop drops measurably after deployment (memory tool result is a major fraction of cached prefix).
Unit test confirms truncation marker is present and byte count is bounded.
Live test on Gruyere run shows picker continues to use memory tool meaningfully after truncation.
must_not_touch: api/app/services/assessment_loop.py (only the log message lines may change to show truncation activity)

acceptance_criteria: View results are bounded at 2 KB.
Truncation marker present and parseable by Claude.
No regression in memory_backend write/create/str_replace tests.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
